reviews.text: I'm so incredibly grateful for Miguel's work. He's a true professional and a wonderful guy who inspires so much confidence. It's clear he loves what he does and genuinely cares and wants to help. Thanks to his help and advice, life and walks with Mapi are becoming more and more normal every day. I highly recommend him to anyone who needs help with their furry friend. I'm still following his advice and would definitely call him again if I ever need him. Thank you so much!
I always recommend him. He's an excellent professional. I had a last-minute problem once, and he got in touch with me very quickly. I wish there were more people like him.

Miguel is a really great guy who helped me train my dog, Leia.

My dog ​​used to pull a lot on the leash, and Miguel explained to both my partner and me how to fix it. Now our walks are much more relaxed.
He's walked her several times, and on rainy days he's been very accommodating and has rescheduled for another day, since I don't want my dog ​​to get wet and, even more importantly, not enjoy her walk. 100% recommended, amazing value for money! 😊

Whenever we need someone, we call Miguel. He's wonderful to us and especially to Simba. He's a fantastic dog trainer, very affectionate, and you can tell he loves animals. I recommend him without hesitation, as we've been relying on him for a long time and he's never let us down. Thank you!
